text: README.md specifies the JSON return envelope for `--json` output with `schema_version`, `command`, `status`, `run_id`, `data`, `errors`, `warnings`, and `metrics`, plus exit codes `0`, `1`, and `64`. It also describes `og sync` as the production reconciliation pipeline `distill -> apply -> verify -> export` and summarizes the responsibilities of `verify`, `replay`, `explain`, `drift`, `status`, `mcp-server`, `optimize prompts`, `autopilot`, and `daemon`.
